_read_me: Allowlist of job sources. Safe defaults: only change the limits if you have read the source's terms and accept the responsibility. Never add sites that need a login or whose terms forbid automated access. See docs/sources.md.

himalayas.name: Himalayas
himalayas.duties: Name Himalayas and link to the job page; keep applicationLink unchanged; drop expired or closed jobs; show the jobs only in apps you operate, never pass them on to other job boards or aggregators.

remoteok.name: Remote OK
remoteok.kind: official public JSON API (latest jobs, one request)
remoteok.duties: Name Remote OK as the source and link to the Remote OK job page; do not use the Remote OK logo.
